title: Four Poses of Yellow Mech Boy
description: Four identical views of a stylized young male character with spiky blonde hair, wearing a bulky black and yellow armored mech suit with oversized gauntlets and boots. The figures are arranged horizontally in slight variations of a combat stance against a plain dark gradient background.
prompt: A young male character with messy spiky blonde hair and an aggressive facial expression, wearing a bulky black and bright yellow mechanical armored suit with large gauntlets, knee pads, and boots. He stands in a combat ready pose with clenched fists. Four nearly identical views of the same character are displayed side by side in a horizontal row, digital character concept art, clean studio lighting, dark gradient background
